Phase: First public release. v0.8.26 remains the runtime-proven FG/HDR/Dynamic core; v1.0.0 promotes the stabilized Control-native UI, persistence, packaging, and RTX 40-series policy branch.

DynamicMFG.VSyncPolicy: Retain v0.8.24: force Present/Present1 SyncInterval=0 only while user mode is Dynamic and DLSS-G is API-enabled; preserve requested SyncInterval otherwise
DynamicMFG.Rationale: v0.8.26 runtime PASS proved Dynamic MFG after adding PCL eSimulationStart. v1.0.0 makes no Dynamic-generation changes.
DynamicMFG.ReflexLimiterPolicy: Dynamic: frameLimitUs = round(1000000 / resolved target FPS); fixed/off: frameLimitUs = 0
DynamicMFG.ReflexLimiterReapply: Reapply slReflexSetOptions when the Dynamic target changes; restore zero on leaving Dynamic
DynamicMFG.PCLSimulationStartPolicy: Emit eSimulationStart once per Control beginFrame, after slReflexSleep, on the same frame token used for constants/tags/present markers.
DynamicMFG.PCLUnimplementedMarkers: Do not fabricate SimulationEnd or RenderSubmitStart/End; identify real Control boundaries before adding them.

Overlay.Presentation: Win32 layered topmost no-activate process-local panel; hidden at startup and toggled with F10
Overlay.Title: Embedded CONTROL FG approved wordmark resource
Overlay.VisualStyle: Control-native black/white/red menu aesthetic with Bahnschrift condensed typography, square controls, white selected state with black text, thick Dynamic target slider, and no side scrollbar
Overlay.Position: Top-right of the Control game client with 18px inset

RTX40SeriesPolicy.Detection: DXGI adapter Description matched by active D3D12 device LUID; GeForce RTX 40 prefix only
